g.text: Never connect raw ECHO directly to ESP.

g.desc: Never connect raw ECHO directly to ESP.

g.text: Terminal labels show electrical connections, not physical pin order. Follow VCC/TRIG/ECHO/GND on your board.

g.desc: Terminal labels show electrical connections, not physical pin order. Follow VCC/TRIG/ECHO/GND on your board.

g.text: Firmware allocation: GPIO1 trigger, GPIO2 echo. Existing S3 media/servo firmware does not yet read this sensor.

g.desc: Firmware allocation: GPIO1 trigger, GPIO2 echo. Existing S3 media/servo firmware does not yet read this sensor.

g.text: Use battery RUN mode for sensor tests; do not feed the sensor from the raw 2S battery or the ESP 3V3 rail.

g.desc: Use battery RUN mode for sensor tests; do not feed the sensor from the raw 2S battery or the ESP 3V3 rail.

g.text: D0 / GPIO1 -> TRIG | D1 / GPIO2 <- divided ECHO | 5V from UBEC | common ground

g.desc: D0 / GPIO1 -> TRIG | D1 / GPIO2 <- divided ECHO | 5V from UBEC | common ground

g.text: C2 across VCC/GND, close to sensor.

g.desc: C2 across VCC/GND, close to sensor.

g.text: TRIG is a 3.3V pulse, at least 10us.

g.desc: TRIG is a 3.3V pulse, at least 10us.

g.text: Verify trigger response on your sensor.
